text: Ivermectin is an effective treatment for COVID-19.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.note: 44% probably false, 22% definitely false. KFF offered definitely/probably true and probably/definitely false; the small remainder gave no answer.

truthSource.label: IDSA, COVID-19 treatment guidelines
truthSource.oneLine: IDSA’s COVID-19 treatment guideline recommends against using ivermectin to treat COVID-19.

lesson.tip: Small early studies can look promising and then fail in large trials. Check what the best and latest evidence says, not the first headline.
